Quinoa cottage cheese bake

Túrós quinoa

8 months+ Adjusted 40 min 4 portions

Serve warm. The grains should be soft, not separate and dry.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g Quinoa (Rinsed)
  • 200 ml Water (For cooking the quinoa)
  • 200 g Cottage cheese (Pasteurized)
  • 1 Egg (Baked until fully set)

Allergens

milkegg

Method

  1. Simmer the quinoa in the water until soft and the water is absorbed.
  2. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  3. Stir the cottage cheese and egg through the cooked quinoa.
  4. Spread in a small dish.
  5. Bake until the egg is set and the middle is no longer liquid, about 20 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and spoon out soft servings.

Adjusted

The usual version was described as needing no cooking, which would leave the egg unset and the quinoa firm. Raw egg is not served.

Cook the quinoa, then bind it with pasteurized cottage cheese and egg and bake until the egg is set. Add no sugar.
